gorseller.istem: A cosy Turkish home kitchen at night with one warm wall lamp switched on; on the white wall right next to the lamp clings a Mediterranean house gecko (Hemidactylus turcicus): small lizard with four short legs, translucent pale pinkish-grey skin covered with tiny raised bumps, large lidless eyes with vertical slit pupils, wide flattened toe tips with adhesive pads, tail with alternating dark and light bands, seen clearly. Copper pots, a tiled backsplash, quiet night outside the window.

Close-up of a Mediterranean house gecko (Hemidactylus turcicus): small lizard with four short legs, translucent pale pinkish-grey skin covered with tiny raised bumps, large lidless eyes with vertical slit pupils, wide flattened toe tips with adhesive pads, tail with alternating dark and light bands on a white plaster wall at night, turning its head to look straight at the viewer, warm lamp light from the side.

A pot of soup simmering on a stove in a Turkish kitchen at night, a ladle and bread on the counter; high on the wall above, small and far from the food, clings a Mediterranean house gecko (Hemidactylus turcicus): small lizard with four short legs, translucent pale pinkish-grey skin covered with tiny raised bumps, large lidless eyes with vertical slit pupils, wide flattened toe tips with adhesive pads, tail with alternating dark and light bands.
An Aegean coastal town in Türkiye at dusk: whitewashed stone houses with blue shutters and terracotta roofs, bougainvillea, old street lamps just switched on, the calm sea behind. No animals visible.

Detailed naturalist side-view portrait of a Mediterranean house gecko (Hemidactylus turcicus): small lizard with four short legs, translucent pale pinkish-grey skin covered with tiny raised bumps, large lidless eyes with vertical slit pupils, wide flattened toe tips with adhesive pads, tail with alternating dark and light bands resting on an old stone wall, every bump on the skin and the banded tail visible, soft evening light.

An old harbour at night: a cargo ship moored at the quay, wooden crates and sacks stacked on the dock under a lamp; on the side of one crate sits a tiny a Mediterranean house gecko (Hemidactylus turcicus): small lizard with four short legs, translucent pale pinkish-grey skin covered with tiny raised bumps, large lidless eyes with vertical slit pupils, wide flattened toe tips with adhesive pads, tail with alternating dark and light bands.

Daytime: a Mediterranean house gecko (Hemidactylus turcicus): small lizard with four short legs, translucent pale pinkish-grey skin covered with tiny raised bumps, large lidless eyes with vertical slit pupils, wide flattened toe tips with adhesive pads, tail with alternating dark and light bands hiding in a narrow crack of a sunlit plaster wall just under the edge of terracotta roof tiles, only its head and front legs visible.

Night: an outdoor wall lamp on a stone house glowing warmly, several moths and small flies circling it; on the wall just below the lamp waits a Mediterranean house gecko (Hemidactylus turcicus): small lizard with four short legs, translucent pale pinkish-grey skin covered with tiny raised bumps, large lidless eyes with vertical slit pupils, wide flattened toe tips with adhesive pads, tail with alternating dark and light bands, watching the insects.

Action moment at night: a Mediterranean house gecko (Hemidactylus turcicus): small lizard with four short legs, translucent pale pinkish-grey skin covered with tiny raised bumps, large lidless eyes with vertical slit pupils, wide flattened toe tips with adhesive pads, tail with alternating dark and light bands lunging forward on a wall to snatch a small moth near a lamp, body stretched, mouth open toward the moth.

Scientific naturalist illustration seen from underneath a pane of glass: the underside of a gecko foot pressed on the glass, five wide toe tips each with a row of thin parallel leaf-like pads (lamellae), delicate detail, soft studio light.

Looking up at a white ceiling at night: a Mediterranean house gecko (Hemidactylus turcicus): small lizard with four short legs, translucent pale pinkish-grey skin covered with tiny raised bumps, large lidless eyes with vertical slit pupils, wide flattened toe tips with adhesive pads, tail with alternating dark and light bands walking upside down across the ceiling near a hanging lamp, its toe pads gripping.

Magnified scientific illustration in the same painted style: a forest of microscopic hair-like bristles (setae) on a gecko toe pad, each bristle branching at its tip into hundreds of tiny flat spatula-shaped ends touching a smooth surface. Elegant, clear, educational.

Close-up of a Mediterranean house gecko (Hemidactylus turcicus): small lizard with four short legs, translucent pale pinkish-grey skin covered with tiny raised bumps, large lidless eyes with vertical slit pupils, wide flattened toe tips with adhesive pads, tail with alternating dark and light bands on a wall licking its own large lidless eye with its pink tongue stretched up over the eye, vertical slit pupil visible.

Night on a garden wall lit by a lamp: two Mediterranean house geckos facing each other a short distance apart, one with its mouth slightly open as if calling; each is a Mediterranean house gecko (Hemidactylus turcicus): small lizard with four short legs, translucent pale pinkish-grey skin covered with tiny raised bumps, large lidless eyes with vertical slit pupils, wide flattened toe tips with adhesive pads, tail with alternating dark and light bands.
A clean Turkish kitchen counter in daylight: hands washing with soap under a running tap, nearby bowls of food covered with lids and a clean cloth. Calm and tidy. No animals.

On a wall ledge at night: a Mediterranean house gecko (Hemidactylus turcicus): small lizard with four short legs, translucent pale pinkish-grey skin covered with tiny raised bumps, large lidless eyes with vertical slit pupils, wide flattened toe tips with adhesive pads, tail with alternating dark and light bands whose tail is a short regrowing stump in a plain uniform colour without bands, while a detached banded tail piece lies on the ledge nearby.

Inside a crevice of an old stone wall: two small round white hard-shelled eggs tucked between the stones; next to the crevice sits a Mediterranean house gecko (Hemidactylus turcicus): small lizard with four short legs, translucent pale pinkish-grey skin covered with tiny raised bumps, large lidless eyes with vertical slit pupils, wide flattened toe tips with adhesive pads, tail with alternating dark and light bands.

Kotschy's gecko (Mediodactylus kotschyi) on a sunlit rocky stone wall: a slender small grey-brown gecko with dark wavy crossbands on the back, thin long bent toes WITHOUT wide adhesive pads, banded tail, vertical pupils. Accurate field-guide illustration.

Two careful hands placing an upturned drinking glass over a Mediterranean house gecko (Hemidactylus turcicus): small lizard with four short legs, translucent pale pinkish-grey skin covered with tiny raised bumps, large lidless eyes with vertical slit pupils, wide flattened toe tips with adhesive pads, tail with alternating dark and light bands on a white wall and sliding a thin piece of cardboard underneath it. Gentle, calm.
A Turkish home balcony at night: a window with a fine insect screen, and a yellow light bulb glowing in the outdoor lamp instead of a white one, a few moths far away. No animals in focus.

A peaceful summer night on a stone garden wall beside a warm lamp, moths circling the light, jasmine flowers; on the wall rests a Mediterranean house gecko (Hemidactylus turcicus): small lizard with four short legs, translucent pale pinkish-grey skin covered with tiny raised bumps, large lidless eyes with vertical slit pupils, wide flattened toe tips with adhesive pads, tail with alternating dark and light bands, calm, as if keeping watch.

Dramatic close-up of a Mediterranean house gecko (Hemidactylus turcicus): small lizard with four short legs, translucent pale pinkish-grey skin covered with tiny raised bumps, large lidless eyes with vertical slit pupils, wide flattened toe tips with adhesive pads, tail with alternating dark and light bands on the right side of the frame on a wall, head turned toward the viewer, the big lidless eye with vertical pupil sharp and glowing with warm rim light; the left half of the image is a plain dark softly blurred night background, empty.
